scripts.compile:circuit: cd circuits/vote && HOME=$INIT_CWD XDG_CACHE_HOME=$INIT_CWD/.cache nargo compile
scripts.build:verifier: bb write_vk --oracle_hash keccak -b circuits/vote/target/private_vote.json -o circuits/vote/target && mkdir -p contracts/src/verifiers && bb write_solidity_verifier -k circuits/vote/target/vk -o contracts/src/verifiers/HonkVerifier.sol
scripts.build: npm run compile:circuit && npm run build:verifier && forge build
